products.name: Survey Package
products.blurb: Survey only. We set up the survey and send you the link; the raw data is returned when the survey closes. No national-norms report and no interactive dashboard.

products.name: Basic Report Package
products.blurb: Survey setup, the link and the raw data, plus a report comparing your institution’s data to national norms once norms are established for the semester, plus an interactive dashboard for disaggregation by gender and race/ethnicity.

products.name: Expanded Report Package
products.blurb: We administer the survey from an email list you provide, with up to 10 institution-specific questions included. You receive the raw data, the norms-comparison report, the interactive dashboard, and a predictive model specific to your campus — conditional on more than 300 responses.

products.name: Thriving Campus Package with One-Hour Webinar
products.blurb: Any five instruments administered within a one-year period, with up to 10 institution-specific questions per survey. Raw data, a norms-comparison report for each of the five, a predictive model per survey (with more than 300 responses) and interactive dashboards. Plus a one-hour webinar with Dr. Schreiner: results, recommended actions and national trends, synthesised across all five surveys with a thematic analysis of comments. Unlimited stakeholders, recordable.

products.name: Additional Institution-Specific Questions (5 items)
products.blurb: Additional institution-specific questions, in groups of five, added to your survey.

products.name: Additional Demographic Variable (Interactive Dashboard)
products.blurb: An additional demographic variable in the interactive dashboard of a report package.

products.name: One-Hour Webinar with Dr. Laurie Schreiner
products.blurb: A standalone one-hour webinar with Dr. Schreiner for the leaders of your institution.

products.name: Researcher Option
products.note: proposal-first; payment link sent after the signed proposal is returned
products.blurb: Use of the instrument for research, and/or use of a dataset (dataset access is for dissertation students only). Requires a submitted proposal.
